e.title: SmaRP (Smart Retirement Planning)
e.summary: 瑞士养老金规划 Shiny 应用（22★，Mirai Solutions）：三支柱养老金基金演算，假设全披露
e.body:
SmaRP（miraisolutions/SmaRP，22★）是 Mirai Solutions（瑞士精算/数据科学咨询）的智能退休规划应用：基于瑞士养老金制度（三支柱体系）的 R Shiny 养老金计算器——交互式计算退休基金随时间的演变（分列各组成部分），可下载含计算方法和近似的报告；开源使底层假设与计算完全披露。对 RIAA：养老金/退休规划的可视化计算案例（瑞士三支柱 vs 香港 [[mpfa]]/[[mpfe]] 体系对照）——与 [[retirement-planning]]（概念）、[[actuarialmath]]（年金计算）配套；池中首个养老金工具，填补 pension 维度。

e.summary_hk: 瑞士養老金規劃 Shiny 應用（22★，Mirai Solutions）：三支柱養老金基金演算，假設全披露
e.body_en:
SmaRP (miraisolutions/SmaRP, 22★) is Mirai Solutions' (a Swiss actuarial/data-science consultancy) Smart Retirement Planning app: an R Shiny pension calculator based on the Swiss pension system (three-pillar framework) — it interactively computes and displays the evolution of retirement funds over time, split into contributing components, and can generate a downloadable report with calculation methodology and approximations; its open-source nature fully discloses the underlying assumptions. For RIAA: a visual retirement/pension-planning case study (Swiss three-pillar vs the Hong Kong [[mpfa]]/[[mpfe]] systems) — pairs with [[retirement-planning]] (the concept) and [[actuarialmath]] (annuity maths); the first pension tool in the pool, filling the pension dimension.
